commitments.detail: will handle with care during cleaning and mounting
will ensure quilt is presented in a way that honors its history
Ensure the quilt is displayed carefully to prevent damage.
Use gentle methods to clean and mount the quilt.
Organize the quilt's display as part of the family gathering.
Store quilt in a cool, dry place when not on display.
Handle quilt with care, avoiding direct contact with skin.
Maya will ensure the quilt is displayed properly and protected during the exhibition.
Family members are encouraged to handle the quilt gently and avoid direct contact.
